entries.title: The Binding of Isaac
entries.definitive_edition: The Binding of Isaac on Windows PC with Wrath of the Lamb

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam release; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Original Steam release with Wrath of the Lamb
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best way to archive the original Flash-era game because it is the original release route, supports the Wrath of the Lamb expansion, and keeps the 2011 game's feel separate from the later Rebirth remake.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Binding of Isaac and Wrath of the Lamb on Steam for Windows PC when you specifically want the 2011 original; play Rebirth separately for the modern remake and expanded content.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Adobe Flash PC release with the Wrath of the Lamb expansion available on Steam.
all_releases.reason: primary: original release route with the expansion and straightforward PC capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Original desktop ports of the same Flash-era game.
all_releases.reason: skip: same original content family; Windows PC remains the preferred capture and compatibility target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth and its DLC are more complete and technically modern, but they are a separate remake entry; choose the original PC release only when the 2011 Flash-era game itself is the subject.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not collapse the original into Rebirth; Rebirth is a remake with a different engine and substantially expanded content.

entries.title: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
entries.definitive_edition: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth on Windows PC with Afterbirth, Afterbirth+, Repentance, and Repentance+

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam version with the complete DLC chain installed; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with current DLC, modding support, and online co-op features.

primary.version: Current Steam release with Afterbirth, Afterbirth+, Repentance, and Repentance+
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the remake, the full major DLC chain, official mod support from Afterbirth+, the Repentance content path, and the free Repentance+ online-co-op update on Steam. Console routes are strong access routes, especially the Repentance releases, but PC is the safest current complete and capture-friendly build.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth on Steam for Windows PC, install Afterbirth, Afterbirth+, Repentance, and the free Repentance+ DLC, then archive from the current PC build.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC remake release with the current Steam DLC chain through Repentance+.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete current content route, PC capture/settings flexibility, official mod support, and the latest sourced Repentance+ feature path.

all_releases.fidelity: Native desktop routes for the base remake family.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful desktop access routes, but Windows PC is the current complete Steam target for the full Repentance+ path.

all_releases.fidelity: Sony console and handheld release route for Rebirth.
all_releases.reason: skip: console/handheld access route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over the current Windows PC route.

all_releases.platform: Xbox One / Wii U / New Nintendo 3DS
all_releases.reason: skip: useful access routes, but older platform limits make them weaker archive targets than current Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Mobile and Apple TV route with controller support noted on the App Store.
all_releases.reason: skip: convenient mobile route, but not the complete current PC DLC/modding path.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable console route; the Switch release included Afterbirth and Afterbirth+ and later received Repentance.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong portable route, but Windows PC remains the current complete route for Repentance+ and capture.
skip: high-quality console route, but PC remains the preferred current complete build because of the Repentance+ Steam path and PC capture flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Console Repentance packages are convenient, but the Windows Steam route has the fullest current feature path through Repentance+ and remains the best capture/modding target.

entries.remaster_caveats: Rebirth is the remake/replacement for most players, but the 2011 Flash original remains a separate historical entry. Repentance+ is represented as part of the current PC Rebirth route rather than a separate standalone game.

entries.title: The Legend of Bum-bo
entries.definitive_edition: The Legend of Bum-bo on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it is the original release platform for the Binding of Isaac prequel, has native PC capture flexibility, and has no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content on later console or Android releases.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Legend of Bum-bo on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

all_releases.reason: primary: original release route with PC capture/settings flexibility.
skip: portable access route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

all_releases.platform: Nintendo Switch / PlayStation 5 / Xbox Series X|S
all_releases.reason: skip: console access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented between PC, Android, and console releases.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a prequel/spinoff in The Binding of Isaac universe, not DLC for Rebirth.
